WHERE p.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND ( UPPER(p.PARTNER_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(p.PARTNER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER_NAME, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_NAME, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_partner.* FROM ( SELECT p.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, p.PARTNER_NAME, a.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, a.ASSIGNEE_NAME, p.ACTIVE_FLAG FROM BIZ_PARTNER p LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON p.ASSIGNEE_ID = a.ASSIGNEE_ID
ORDER BY p.PARTNER_CODE ASC ) ordered_partner WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageNum} * #{amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{pageNum} - 1) * #{amount} ORDER BY PARTNER_CODE ASC

SELECT p.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, p.PARTNER_NAME, a.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, a.ASSIGNEE_NAME, p.ACTIVE_FLAG FROM BIZ_PARTNER p LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON p.ASSIGNEE_ID = a.ASSIGNEE_ID WHERE p.PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId}
